description: Retrieves a Together-hosted base model and the certified model, configuration, hardware, and performance profiles available for deployment.

DE.SupportedModel.description: Curated catalog entry for a platform-supported model.

architecture.description: Model architecture from the underlying weights metadata.

baseModel.description: Resource name for the base model as `projects/{projectId}/models/{modelId}`; empty when unresolved.

baseModelId.description: Bare model ID for the architecture's base model; empty when no base model is linked.

contextLength.description: Maximum context length from the underlying weights metadata.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the catalog entry was created.

deploymentProfiles.description: Certified deployment profiles available for the model.

displayType.description: UI-facing model type badge, such as chat, language, code, image, embedding, rerank, moderation, audio, video, or transcribe.

familyId.description: Model family identifier for related catalog entries.

features.description: Advanced features exposed by the model.

id.description: Unique ID of the deployable Together-hosted base model.

inputFormat.description: Preferred input format for the model.

inputModalities.description: Input modalities supported by the model.

name.description: Catalog-controlled HF model ID used for inference.

outputFormat.description: Preferred output format for the model.

outputModalities.description: Output modalities produced by the model.

products.description: Product surfaces where the model is offered.

publisher.description: Organization or publisher associated with the model.

serverlessEndpoint.description: Serverless endpoint name for inference, if available.

status.description: Catalog recommendation status for the model.

tags.description: Searchable catalog tags for the model.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the catalog entry was last updated.

DE.SupportedModelDeploymentProfile.description: Certified deployment profile for a supported model.

certifiedModelRevisionId.description: Certified model weight revision identifier, if available.

config.description: Certified config revision in the form `projects/{projectId}/configs/{configRevisionId}`. Omitted when the profile does not pin a config.

gpuCount.description: Number of GPUs required by the profile.

gpuType.description: GPU instance type for the profile.

model.description: Deployable model resource in the form `projects/{projectId}/models/{modelId}[/revisions/{revisionId}]`. Omitted when the profile does not pin model weights.

modelName.description: Fully-qualified deploy model name in the form `{projectSlug}/{modelName}`, such as `Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B-FP8`; empty when no public model is linked.

parallelism.description: Free-form parallelism spec for the profile, such as TP8, TP4, EP, or PD; supersedes tensor_parallel_size.

performanceBenchmarks.description: Performance benchmarks for the profile, if available.

profileId.description: Stable profile identifier, usually the certified config id.

quantization.description: Quantization method for the profile, if available.

tensorParallelSize.description: Deprecated. Use `parallelism`. Legacy tensor-parallel shard count for the profile.

DE.SupportedModelPerformanceBenchmarks.description: Performance benchmark metrics for a supported model profile.

decodingSpeedTps.description: Decoding throughput in tokens per second.

maxContextLength.description: Maximum context length supported by the profile.

timeToFirstTokenMs.description: Time to first token in milliseconds.
